name: markloop
description: Share the HTML documents your AI writes on Markloop, collect anchored comments from your team or clients, then read the threads, apply the changes and publish the next version at the same link.

interface.longDescription:
Markloop turns the HTML documents your AI writes (specs, proposals, plans, reports) into one link your team or clients can comment on. Reviewers click an element or select text and leave a comment, with no account needed on a public link.

With the Markloop plugin, your AI works the review loop for you:
- publishes a document into a Markloop project and gives you the link,
- reads the open comments as full threads, each with the exact sentence it is about,
- applies the changes and publishes the next version at the same link, marking which comments it addressed,
- replies in a thread when it needs an answer, and compares any two versions,
- sends a clean copy to a client's project, without your internal comments.

Markloop never deletes anything through the plugin: writes add a document, a version or a comment. You choose which workspaces and projects the plugin can reach when you sign in. Markloop runs no AI model on its servers; all editing happens in your AI tool.
capabilities: Publish new versions at the same link
Send clean copies to client projects
defaultPrompt: Publish this HTML document to Markloop so my team can comment on it.
What did reviewers say about my spec in Markloop? Group the comments by section.
Address the open comments on my spec and publish the next version in Markloop.
